Indian Auto Sales Soften in September After August Records

Shares of Indian auto companies declined in September after reaching record highs in August. Hyundai reported record sales for September, selling 77,916 units, a significant increase from previous periods. Other auto companies also saw sales figures, with Nissan reporting wholesale of 10,025 units in September, doubling its domestic sales.
